jokes.setup: Real estate analysts describe the sudden exodus from outdated commercial buildings as a flight to quality.
jokes.punchline: Which is corporate speak for employees refusing to work near visible asbestos.

jokes.setup: The report warns that empty, aging office space will likely sit vacant for decades.
jokes.punchline: Mostly because nobody wants to commute forty minutes to sit under flickering fluorescent bulbs.

jokes.setup: Commercial landlords with older buildings are facing a massive surplus of unrented square footage.
jokes.punchline: Their best option is marketing the gray cubicles as authentic period film sets.

jokes.setup: While modern luxury towers are fully booked, decades-old office buildings are completely abandoned.
